hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or internal access to Kael or Desh.

Use Star Wars Legends terminology: hydrospanner (Legends canon tool), power-cycle draw as 'power fluctuations' or 'energy cycling irregularity' if needed; avoid anachronisms like 'laptop' (use datapad), 'computer' (use console).
No in-universe use of publishing terms like 'Legends' or 'Canon'; no ABY/BBY dates spoken by characters.
Force descriptions: experiential and mystical per Legends; no clinical framing. This scene is non-Force-focused (practical observation, mechanical work).
'Jedi' singular and plural; 'Darth' capitalized only before name.
American English; capitalize 'Human'; lowercase 'galaxy' unless sentence start.
canon_risks: Ensure Desh Rolan (OC, former GAG) aligns with post-LotF era: GAG dissolved after Caedus's defeat; his service is shared shame with Ben, not active affiliation.
Kael Drenn's agency here (initiating with Desh) must not contradict his AU backstory as conscripted Sith trainee repurposed as anchor; treat as first voluntary operational act.
Steady Returns as modified YT-series freighter: consistent with Legends (e.g., YT-1300 like Falcon); engineering crawlspace fits cramped freighter design.
legends_continuity_notes: Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight, ~21 ABY age fits 47 ABY (post-FotJ); GAG service under Jacen/Caedus canonical (Legacy of the Force).
Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG): Canonical secret police from LotF; Ben and Desh's teen service is preserved canon.
Post-FotJ era (47 ABY): Jedi Order under Luke on Coruscant; no Empire/First Order; focus on personal stakes, no galaxy-spanning politics here.
YT-series freighters: Common Legends civilian ships; engineering bays cramped, tool-heavy (hydrospanners, fusion torches canonical).
required_context_for_drafter: Scene aboard Steady Returns engineering crawlspace: Desh's domain, cramped for one, now two.
Kael initiates unprompted with practical observation (e.g., power-cycle draw pattern matching conduit failure); Desh absorbs without fanfare, asks for hydrospanner after deliberate stillness.
Ben observes briefly from corridor en route to cockpit; registers alliance without interpreting/narrating it.
Quiet-alliance dyad (Kael/Desh): lives in tools, competence, observation; no overt bonding or explanation.
Emotional arc: residual tension -> purposeful work -> smallest warmth (Kael near-smile).
Anti-patterns: no Kael interiority explanation; no Ben analytical underline ('Kael acting differently'); gesture is exposition.
Primary anchor: Allston (two-voice warmth via Desh's flat operational vs. Kael's brevity); supporting: Zahn (procedural frame).
allowed_au_divergences: Kael Drenn: AU New Sith Wars Sith conscript/anchor survivor; his Weave-navigability and initiation here per project force_mechanics and ensemble_cast.
Desh Rolan: AU OC former GAG operative, non-Force-sensitive; his role as operational anchor preserved.
Steady Returns: AU modified YT-series freighter, Desh's personal vessel.
Group dynamics: Kael/Desh quiet alliance as authorized relationship arc (W1 Inversion 1).
